strips.title: A day with the Dreo space heater — in real life

panels.head: Cold desk, 6 a.m.
panels.text: Set the thermostat to 68°F and press the remote. Heat starts in seconds.

panels.head: Wall outlet only
panels.text: Plug straight into the wall, not a power strip. CPSC says so, and Dreo's manual agrees.

panels.head: Keep 3 feet clear
panels.text: Nothing within three feet: no curtains, bedding or laundry piles (CPSC, Jan 2026).

panels.head: Eco mode, then off
panels.text: Eco stops heating at the set temperature. Turn it off when you leave or sleep.
